dedupe_keys.name: sysmo sweden matsim input and trajectory processing pipeline

description: This repository supplies the processing pipeline used to prepare and analyse SySMo travel agents for Sweden. Chalmers collaborators provide Python scripts, Jupyter notebooks and a MATSim configuration covering input preparation, activity-plan merging, event processing, feasibility filtering and product summaries. The README describes an average weekday, with the national agents simulated in ten batches using a configuration based on MATSim 13.0. GitHub identifies an MIT licence and permits free access to the code. The repository orchestrates preparation and post-processing; MATSim and the required population and network data remain external dependencies. A limitation is the exclusion of negative-utility or negative-duration plans, which changes the represented population subset. A reviewer-assessed use is rebuilding transport-simulation inputs or evaluating how filtering affects mobility scenarios. model-matsim is the stated simulation environment, while data-sweden-synthetic-bev-travel-charging-demand is a related regional application. No source archive, notebook, simulation or dependency installation was executed.
